subject: BridgeGrant pilot — compute credit extension & waiver request
messages:
From: Dr. Laila Ahmed <laila@ethoslab.org>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: BridgeGrant pilot - 60d extension & compute waiver

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for onboarding Ethos Research Lab onto the Redwood pilot last month — the model latency and cost visibility have been great so far. We're running a time-sensitive component of our BridgeGrant fellowship that requires additional compute: a delayed IRB sign-off pushed several of our evaluation runs into November and our current promo allocation will be exhausted mid-month.

Would Redwood consider a one-time extension (60 days) and a supplemental promotional credit to cover roughly 60k token-equivalent usage? We can share the updated pilot plan and the IRB note; our funding partner is unable to fast-track more budget.

Attached: bridgegrant_pilot_proposal.pdf (proposal, milestones) and usage_snapshot_Oct2026.csv (current usage).

We appreciate any flexible program you can offer for academic fellows — happy to accept a conditional extension tied to a short follow-up survey about production feasibility.

Best,
Laila
Dr. Laila Ahmed
Director, Applied Social AI
Ethos Research Lab
laila@ethoslab.org

Ben / Priyom — forwarding a small but urgent ask from Ethos Research Lab (Laila). They hit an IRB delay and need an extra 60 days + ~60k token-equivalent promo to finish the fellowship deliverable.

Why it matters: this group has a high-profile funder, several publications in the pipeline, and positive feedback on Redwood performance. Granting a one-time extension could lead to an institutional pilot + expansion next quarter (they indicated potential for Dedicated conversation).

Can we offer a promotional credit + a short-term extension? Ben, would you own the customer comms and tie the extension to a one-page feedback survey? Priyom, tagging you for approval on any credit over 25k tokens.

Thanks — I can loop in CS if you want ongoing monitoring.

— Hannah

Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: BridgeGrant pilot - 60d extension & compute waiver

Thanks Hannah — I reviewed their usage snapshot. Quick summary: they used ~18k token-equivalent in October but have ramped tests planned that could consume another 65–80k over 60 days if they run the full eval slate.

Proposed options we can offer quickly:
- Option A (fast, low approval): 25k promo credit + 60-day extension tied to a 1-page feedback survey.
- Option B (requires manager approval): 60k promo credit + 60-day extension + one-time 50% discount on overage for academic projects until pilot end.

If Priyom approves Option B, I'll prepare a short DocuSign for Laila to accept pilot terms and we'll CC CSM for instrumentation. If we go with A, I can approve it directly.

Deal note: DL-4297 (BridgeGrant — Ethos Research Lab). I recommend Option B if we think this will convert to a Dedicated pilot; Option A if we want a minimal commitment.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Research Programs
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: BridgeGrant pilot - 60d extension & compute waiver

Appreciate the context. Approve Option B as a one-time promotional exception: 60k promo credit + 60-day extension + 50% overage discount limited to this pilot period.

Conditions:
- Credit expires 60 days from activation.
- Customer signs the short pilot amendment (DocuSign).
- CSM to monitor usage and flag if consumption pattern suggests production ramp (then finance will re-evaluate).

Hannah — please coordinate a brief intro call with the assigned CSM (loop in Monica Patel) and have Ben issue the DocuSign. Finance should be copied on the DocuSign packet.

— Priyom
Head of Academic Partnerships
priyom_das@redwood.ai
